# CIMMYT

> CIMMYT is a global agricultural research organization focused on maize and wheat breeding, sustainable farming systems, and food security across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.

CIMMYT (International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center) is a CGIAR research organization conducting cutting-edge agricultural research to address climate change, food security, and sustainable crop production. The organization operates breeding programs, germplasm banks, and capacity development initiatives across multiple continents.

## Key Topics

- maize
- wheat
- food security
- climate resilience
- agricultural research
- genetic resources
- sustainable agriculture
- capacity development

- Asia
- CGIAR
- agrifood systems
- climate adaptation

## Core Research Programs

- [Our work](https://www.cimmyt.org/work): CIMMYT research programs on maize, wheat, and sustainable agriculture
- [Maize Research](https://www.cimmyt.org/work/maize-research): Maize breeding and seed systems research across Africa and Asia
- [Wheat Research](https://www.cimmyt.org/work/wheat-research): Global Wheat Program with breeding and genomic selection research
- [Dryland Crops](https://www.cimmyt.org/work/dryland-crops): Dryland Crops Program for sorghum and millet breeding in Africa
- [Sustainable Agrifood Systems](https://www.cimmyt.org/work/sustainable-agrifood-systems): Sustainable agriculture and agrifood systems research initiatives
- [Genetic Resources](https://www.cimmyt.org/work/genetic-resources): Seeds of Discovery and germplasm bank for crop breeding

## Research Projects & Initiatives

- [Projects Directory](https://www.cimmyt.org/projects): CIMMYT research projects directory with filters and initiatives
- [Opportunity Crops and Soils (VACS)](https://www.cimmyt.org/projects/opportunity-crops-and-soils-vacs): Vision for Adapted Crops and Soils initiative for climate-resilient agriculture
- [Publications](https://www.cimmyt.org/work/publications): Peer-reviewed publications on maize, wheat, and climate resilience

## Capacity Development & Learning

- [CIMMYT Academy](https://www.cimmyt.org/support-us/alumni/cimmyt-academy): CIMMYT Academy training platform for capacity development
- [Capacity Development News](https://www.cimmyt.org/news/capacity-development): Capacity development news and farmer training across Africa and Asia
- [Alumni Network](https://www.cimmyt.org/support-us/alumni): CIMMYT alumni network for community engagement and professional development

## Resources & Support

- [Seed Request](https://www.cimmyt.org/work/seed-request): Germplasm distribution and seed request form for researchers
- [Careers](https://www.cimmyt.org/careers): Job vacancies, internships, and career opportunities at CIMMYT
- [Make a Donation](https://www.cimmyt.org/make-a-donation): Donation and fundraising page for CIMMYT food security initiatives
